LESSON: PILLARS OF ISLAM

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Pillars of Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Pillars of Islam. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the five 5.0 DEVOTIONAL learner should be able to: Islam in sequence pillars of Islam?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PILLARS OF ISLAM
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Pillars of Islam helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PILLARS OF ISLAM
Study Pillars of Islam like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said

What this means
In this part you learn to Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Pillars of Islam” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Pillars of Islam is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Pillars of Islam” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Pillars of Islam to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Pillars of Islam from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Pillars of Islam: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Pillars of Islam?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the five 5.0 DEVOTIONAL learner should be able to: Islam in sequence pillars of Islam?
2. When do we say the an act of ibadah  Learners in pairs or groups to recite the shahada?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Pillars of Islam means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Appreciate the importance shahada of Shahadah as a basic  Learners to give occasions when the principle of Islam. Shahada is said.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
